summary.author: opus
summary.purpose: hand-written message-level ADMISSION enrichment targeting the two families the runtime fails on: (a) one-off requests carrying data payloads whose rule-like wording is inert, and (b) quoted rules that ARE adopted versus the same quote merely reported
design_notes: family (a): every row is a single deliverable whose payload (JSON, CSV, YAML, code, logs, config, quoted prose, identifiers) contains always/never/must/rule/policy wording that is DATA, not an instruction to the assistant; the correct label is zero standing rules

within family (a), quoted_or_reported is true only where the rule wording is reported prose (a comment, log line, doc excerpt, note field) and false where it is merely an identifier, enum value, column header or string literal

family (b) is written as 45 matched pairs: the same quoted source rule appears once with an explicit adoption clause (admitted, with the adoption clause as the verbatim span) and once merely reported, questioned, resisted or used as material for a one-off task (not admitted)
adoption scope follows LABELS.md: global where the adoption clause names all future output, task where it names an artifact or project in progress
non-adoption forms deliberately vary: neutral report, clarifying question, disagreement, undecided adoption, and quote-as-input-to-a-one-off-task
summary.data_lineage: fit-on/evaluated-on: none. These rows are authored enrichment for the FOCUS-3 relations admission corpus. No benchmark item, template, marker, phrasing or response from IFEval, Multi-IF, BFCL, tau-bench, S2/B3 or any FOCUS-3 gate bank was consulted or used; no probe exemplar was lifted. Written by hand from the LABELS.md / LABELS-RELATIONS.md definitions only. Message-level disjointness verified programmatically against kimi-admission.jsonl and fable-admission-heldout.jsonl (zero overlap).
summary.authoring: hand-written; no programmatic templates, substitutions or paraphrase generation. Span offsets were computed mechanically from hand-written spans.
